messages.content:
Risk: Harmful code generation
Description: Models might generate code that causes harm or unintentionally affects other systems.
Concern: The execution of harmful code might open vulnerabilities in IT systems.
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/Exposure: exposure — the extent to which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty [found by 7/10 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000548: Vulnerability — A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in. [found by 10/10 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 9/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 8/10 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 8/10 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Party: party — person or organization [from restriction: appliesTo on Exposure]
  Siblings: automated system, software agent, Agent

axes.rationale: The risk involves the generation of code that might exploit vulnerabilities in IT systems, making 'Vulnerability' a key object in this context.
The harmful code generated can be considered dangerous information, as it can cause harm when executed, making it a crucial instrument in this risk scenario.
